## Params
```{r}
print(params)
outdir <- params$outdir
```

## Read IPP data
```{r}
prot_data <- read.delim(params$proteomics_ipp_data)
prot_data <- data.frame(t(prot_data))
```

### Feature metadata
```{r}
feature_metadata <- read.delim(params$proteomics_ipp_feature_data)
```

## Replace by Uniprot IDss
```{r}
uniprot_ids <- lapply(colnames(prot_data), function(x) {
  uni <- feature_metadata[feature_metadata$AptName==x, "UniProt"]
  uni
})
colnames(prot_data) <- as.character(uniprot_ids)
```

## Histogram
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

df_long <- prot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric)) %>%
  drop_na()

ggplot(df_long, aes(value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = 'grey', color = 'black')
```


## Save for MAE object
```{r}
prot_data_out <- data.frame(t(prot_data))
write.csv(prot_data_out, 'Z:/omics/Proteomics_IMTM/Upload_2025-05-22_IPP/IPP_log10_batchEffectRemoved_std_UniProt.csv')
```
